column2: Associated data model for the Fleet Management Module BRD and wireframes.
Table names, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, associations, screen-to-field mapping, enumerations, integration mapping and ERD text.
One Build & Release with internal Phase 1 / Phase 2 / Phase 3 tagging.
Start with Table Catalog, review Data Dictionary, then use Screen Field Map to map UI fields to database columns. Use Table Associations for ERD/API design.
This is a logical data model. Physical SQL DDL should be generated after database naming, schema, indexing and partitioning standards are finalised.
